sloka: ततः क्रुद्धस्तु सौदासस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना ।वसिष्ठं शप्तुमारेभे भार्या चैनमवारयत् ।। ७.६५.२९ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ kruddhastu saudāsastoyaṁ jagrāha pāṇinā ।vasiṣṭhaṁ śaptumārebhe bhāryā cainamavārayat ।। 7.65.29 ॥

translations.english: Then, enraged, King Saudasa took water in his hand and began to curse Vasistha, but his wife restrained him.
